clue.text: Pressure put on eminent conceited person

indicators.note: in an across answer one piece put on another follows it

parts.note: an eminent figure is a big name
a head of steam or water is the pressure it builds up

explanation.surface: Someone prominent leans on a self-important person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put on' places HEAD after BIG.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with a swollen opinion of their own importance is called this in everyday speech.

clue.text: Exist as goddesses-in puzzles

parts.note: to be is to exist
the Muses are the nine goddesses of the arts

explanation.surface: Goddesses existing within crosswords.
explanation.walkthrough: The Muses are the nine Greek goddesses of arts and learning.
explanation.definitionFit: To confuse or perplex someone, as a riddle does.

clue.text: Italian boat's propeller for new liner? Good

indicators.note: new says the letters of liner and Good are made new, rearranged

explanation.surface: Asking whether a Venetian oarsman swapped for a new ocean liner is good.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges LINER plus GOOD, nine letters together.
explanation.definitionFit: The man who rows or poles a Venetian gondola drives it along.

clue.text: Conclusions of the ruling party -keep it a republic

indicators.note: the conclusions of words are their final letters, taken from each of the next five words

explanation.surface: The ruling party is urged to keep the country a republic.
explanation.walkthrough: Last letters of 'the ruling party keep it' spell the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A North African country that has been a republic since 1953.

clue.text: Notice result of successful appeal.

explanation.definitionFit: Being given notice means being sacked; in cricket a batter is given out after the fielders appeal successfully.

clue.text: Sailor gets little time, out East, to fly

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor

indicators.note: out tells us the letter for East is dropped from the word for time

parts.note: a second is a little time, a moment

explanation.surface: A seaman takes a brief break and slips away eastwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' removes E from SECOND, leaving SCOND.
explanation.definitionFit: To fly can mean to flee, run off secretly, which is what absconding is.

clue.text: Something played without accompaniment

explanation.definitionFit: A role is something played by an actor; to be away from others is to be on one's own.

clue.text: Capital tree — altogether capital

parts.note: stock is capital, money invested
the holm is the holm oak, an evergreen tree

explanation.surface: A fine tree, and all in all a fine city.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'Capital' is money (STOCK); the second is a capital city. A holm is the holm oak.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital city of Sweden.

clue.text: Take part in home game, last of series

indicators.note: Take part in says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A player joins the home match, the final one of the season.
explanation.definitionFit: The final letter of the Greek alphabet, hence the end of any series.

clue.text: Fabrics for inside vehicle

indicators.note: inside tells us the word for for goes within the word for vehicle

parts.note: a dray is a low cart, used by brewers
per means for, as in so much per head

explanation.surface: Upholstery materials for a car's interior.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inside' places PER (for, as in 'per day') within DRAY, a brewer's cart.
explanation.definitionFit: Cloth goods collectively, as sold by a draper.

clue.text: Letters from my girl

parts.note: reads as correspondence from a sweetheart, but the letters of my, joined by and, give a girl's name

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests letters sent by a girlfriend; instead spell out the letters of 'my' as M and Y.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's first name, so it serves for a girl.

clue.text: Flattery works in TV programme

parts.note: soft soap is flattery, so soap alone can mean it
opera is Latin for works, the plural of opus

explanation.surface: Sweet talk works when you are on a television show.
explanation.walkthrough: OPERA is the Latin plural of opus, a work.
explanation.definitionFit: A serial drama on television, named after the soap makers who sponsored early ones.

clue.text: Little inclination to cut number of candidates

parts.note: little means short
a list is a lean or tilt, as of a ship

explanation.surface: A small tendency to trim a field of applicants.
explanation.walkthrough: A ship's list is its inclination to one side.
explanation.definitionFit: To pick out the strongest few applicants is to reduce the field before a final choice.

clue.text: Honour among thieves?

parts.note: a card counted among the honours in bridge whose name is also an old word for a rogue

explanation.definitionFit: The jack is one of the bridge honours, and the old word for a jack also means a dishonest rogue.

clue.text: Clerical writer, one skilled at forging

explanation.definitionFit: Sydney Smith was a clergyman and essayist; a metalworker who shapes iron at a forge shares the name.

clue.text: Grieved as result of cards or the backing of a horse?

parts.note: hearts are one of the suits of playing cards
taken as written

indicators.note: the backing of a word is its end, so the final letter of horse

explanation.surface: Was the sorrow due to a card game or a bet on a horse?
explanation.walkthrough: 'the backing of' takes the last letter of horse. The surface suggests a gambler's losses.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling deep sorrow, sick at heart.

clue.text: Shakespeare's second-act whiner

parts.note: in the Seven Ages of Man speech from As You Like It, the second age is a whining pupil creeping unwillingly to school

explanation.definitionFit: Jaques describes the second age of man as a whining pupil with a satchel.

clue.text: Leaves without any difficulty

explanation.definitionFit: To leave something to heirs is to pass it on; winning easily is winning by a wide margin.

clue.text: Something outstanding a star contributes to dance

parts.note: a boss is a raised stud or knob, something standing out
a nova is a star that flares suddenly

explanation.surface: A celebrity performer lends brilliance to the dance floor.
explanation.walkthrough: A boss is a projecting knob, as on a shield; outstanding is meant literally.
explanation.definitionFit: A Brazilian samba-like rhythm and the ballroom dance done to it.

clue.text: Waterproof fabric tentmaker and I put in pool

indicators.note: put in tells us the tentmaker and I go inside the word for pool

parts.note: a tarn is a small mountain lake or pool
St Paul worked as a tentmaker, according to Acts

explanation.surface: A tent-maker and a companion set up a waterproof sheet beside a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put in' places PAUL and I inside TARN. St Paul's trade as a tentmaker is a crossword favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavy canvas sheet treated with tar to keep rain out.

clue.text: Local: disturbance in coal-pit

indicators.note: disturbance in says the letters of coal-pit are stirred up

explanation.surface: Trouble at the colliery makes news in the neighbourhood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbance in' rearranges COALPIT.
explanation.definitionFit: In medicine a topical treatment is applied to one area, so it is confined to a spot.

clue.text: What's scored, thus, by leader in Marathon

indicators.note: by means beside, so the pieces sit next to each other

parts.note: the first letter of Marathon, a Greek place, is M, which in Greek is called mu
sic is Latin for thus

explanation.surface: A race report noting who set the pace in the marathon.
explanation.walkthrough: M, the first letter of Marathon, is named as the Greek letter mu, fitting a Greek place-name.
explanation.definitionFit: Compositions are written out in a score, so the notes set down are what gets scored.

clue.text: Shout last order: that's particularly clear

parts.note: to cry is to shout

indicators.note: order tells us the letters of last are rearranged

explanation.surface: A pub landlord bellows last orders, and the message is unmistakable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'order' rearranges LAST into STAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Crystal clear means perfectly transparent or plain, so the word alone means very clear.

clue.text: Like a letter on the way, I assume

indicators.note: a letter on the way is in the post, so I is put inside the word for mail

parts.note: post is mail, as a letter is

explanation.surface: Someone guesses that their letter is still in transit.
explanation.walkthrough: A letter on its way is in the post, which is what puts I inside POST.
explanation.definitionFit: To put something forward as a basis for argument is to take it as given.

clue.text: Stuff with pole 'on top to beat it

indicators.note: in a down answer the piece on top comes first

parts.note: S is the South Pole
to cram is to stuff

explanation.surface: Someone is told to stuff a stick on top and get lost.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on top' puts S above CRAM in this down answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave in a hurry, clear off, is slang for go away.

clue.text: Write about us to girl as usual

parts.note: C, short for circa, means about
taken as written
taken as written
Mary is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Writing to a girlfriend about ourselves as we always do.
explanation.walkthrough: C (circa) means about.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done by habit or convention is the normal, expected way.

clue.text: Alternative to train

parts.note: a long-distance bus is an alternative to rail travel, and the same word as a verb means to train

explanation.definitionFit: A long-distance bus is the other way to travel by land; it also means to tutor.

clue.text: Power of two parts in this musical-piece

definitions.text: Power of two parts in this musical-piece

parts.words: Power of two parts in this musical-piece
parts.note: two cubed is eight, the number of players or voices in this kind of composition

explanation.definitionFit: A composition for eight instruments or voices, eight being two to the third power.

clue.text: Sort of diamond accountant changed on board

parts.note: CA is a chartered accountant

indicators.note: changed tells us the letters of on board are rearranged

explanation.surface: A bookkeeper swaps the gemstone once aboard ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changed' turns ONBOARD into RBONADO.
explanation.definitionFit: A black, opaque form of industrial diamond also known as black diamond.

clue.text: Hagfish?

parts.note: read as a fish that is also a slang term for a hag, an unpleasant old woman

explanation.definitionFit: An old woman of disagreeable manner is called an old one of these freshwater fish.

clue.text: Beat little woman in this walk

parts.note: to lam is to thrash or beat
Beth is one of the March sisters in Little Women

explanation.surface: Thrashing a small woman on a stroll.
explanation.walkthrough: The Lambeth Walk is a cockney song and dance; Beth is one of the four girls in Alcott's Little Women.
explanation.definitionFit: The Lambeth Walk is a 1930s song and strutting dance named after a London street.

clue.text: Clear round object in this sport

parts.note: to net is to clear a sum as profit
a ball is a round object

explanation.surface: In this game you lob a sphere cleanly through the hoop.
explanation.walkthrough: To net or clear a profit is to make it after costs.
explanation.definitionFit: A team game, played mainly in schools, where players shoot a ball through a high ring.
